name: Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge
tagline: Memory-optimized fork of Automatic1111 designed for faster image generation on lower-VRAM GPUs.
real_test_summary: Tested generating SDXL and Flux checkpoints locally on an 8GB VRAM GPU. Custom memory management noticeably reduces out-of-memory errors and speeds up batch sampling compared to stock WebUI setups.
pros: Improved VRAM management enables heavier models on 4GB–8GB GPUs
Familiar Automatic1111-style layout with built-in ControlNet and sampler upgrades
Runs completely offline with zero watermarks or generation limits
cons: Some legacy Automatic1111 third-party extensions may have compatibility issues
Initial Python dependency and checkpoint setup takes several gigabytes of storage
